blocks.zh: 干擾因子測試、結果判讀與重組 Factor C 替代方案
blocks.en: Interference Testing, Interpretation of Results and the Recombinant Factor C Alternative

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握光電法（濁度法/顯色法）的干擾因子測試（Inhibition/Enhancement Test）程序與接受標準
blocks.en: Master the procedure and acceptance criteria for the interference (inhibition/enhancement) test for photometric methods (turbidimetric/chromogenic)

blocks.zh: 理解 50%–200% 內毒素回收率標準的實務意義
blocks.en: Understand the practical meaning of the 50%-200% endotoxin recovery criterion

blocks.zh: 學會光電法的結果計算與有效性判定程序
blocks.en: Learn the calculation of results and the validity determination procedure for photometric methods

blocks.zh: 了解克服干擾因子的策略：稀釋、過濾、中和、透析、加熱處理
blocks.en: Learn the strategies for overcoming interfering factors: dilution, filtration, neutralization, dialysis, heat treatment

blocks.zh: 認識重組 Factor C（rFC）作為 LAL 替代方案的原理、優勢與法規接受度
blocks.en: Understand the principle, advantages and regulatory acceptance of recombinant Factor C (rFC) as an alternative to LAL

blocks.zh: 掌握 USP 內毒素參考標準品（RSE）與 K 值的腳註規定
blocks.en: Master the USP footnote requirements on the Reference Standard Endotoxin (RSE) and the K value

blocks.zh: 2.1 Inhibition/Enhancement Test for Photometric Techniques — 光電法干擾因子測試
blocks.en: 2.1 Inhibition/Enhancement Test for Photometric Techniques

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 干擾因子測試的核心邏輯：你在產品（Solution B）中加入已知量的標準內毒素，然後測量能回收到多少。如果回收率在 50%–200%，表示產品不會顯著干擾測試結果。
blocks.en: Core logic of the interference test: You add a known amount of standard endotoxin to the product (Solution B) and measure how much can be recovered. If recovery is within 50%-200%, the product does not significantly interfere with the test result.

blocks.zh: 兩種干擾類型：
blocks.en: Two types of interference:

blocks.zh: 抑制（Inhibition）：回收率 < 50% — 產品中某些成分（如抗菌劑、螯合劑、極端 pH）抑制了 LAL 反應，導致偽低結果 → 假陰性風險
blocks.en: Inhibition: recovery < 50% - some components of the product (e.g., antimicrobial agents, chelating agents, extreme pH) inhibit the LAL reaction and give falsely low results → risk of false negatives

blocks.zh: 增強（Enhancement）：回收率 > 200% — 產品中某些成分（如 β-glucan、某些蛋白質）促進了反應，導致偽高結果 → 假陽性風險
blocks.en: Enhancement: recovery > 200% - some components of the product (e.g., β-glucan, certain proteins) promote the reaction and give falsely high results → risk of false positives

blocks.zh: 50%–200% 為什麼是可接受的？這是一個 ±1 倍的對數範圍（log±0.3），與凝膠法的 0.5λ–2λ 接受標準在數學上是等價的，反映了 BET 測試固有的生物學變異性。
blocks.en: Why is 50%-200% acceptable? This is a range of ±1 two-fold step on a log scale (log ±0.3). It is mathematically equivalent to the 0.5λ-2λ acceptance criterion of the gel-clot method and reflects the inherent biological variability of the BET.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 血液中的酒精測試比喻：想像你在開發一種新的血液酒精測試方法，但你擔心某些藥物可能干擾測試結果。你會怎麼驗證？
blocks.en: A blood alcohol test analogy: Imagine you are developing a new blood alcohol test, but you are concerned that some drugs may interfere with the result. How would you verify it?

blocks.zh: 你在病患的血液樣品（Solution B）中加入已知濃度的酒精，然後測量。如果你加了 0.08%，測出來是 0.04%–0.16%（50%–200%），代表干擾可接受。如果只測到 0.02%（25%），說明有嚴重抑制 — 這種情況下，用這個方法直接測試這位病患的血液是不可靠的。
blocks.en: You spike a patient's blood sample (Solution B) with a known concentration of alcohol and measure it. If you add 0.08% and read 0.04%-0.16% (50%-200%), the interference is acceptable. If you read only 0.02% (25%), there is severe inhibition - in that case, using this method to test this patient's blood directly is unreliable.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 克服干擾的策略（按常用順序）：
blocks.en: Strategies for overcoming interference (in order of common use):

blocks.zh: 進一步稀釋（最常用）— 稀釋可以降低干擾物的濃度，但不能超過 MVD
blocks.en: Further dilution (most common) - dilution lowers the concentration of the interfering substance, but must not exceed the MVD

blocks.zh: 加熱處理 — 某些干擾蛋白可以透過加熱去活化（通常 70–80°C / 10–15 min）
blocks.en: Heat treatment - some interfering proteins can be inactivated by heating (typically 70-80°C / 10-15 min)

blocks.zh: 過濾 — 使用適當孔徑的濾膜去除干擾顆粒
blocks.en: Filtration - use a filter of appropriate pore size to remove interfering particles

blocks.zh: 中和 — 調整 pH 至 LAL 反應的最適範圍
blocks.en: Neutralization - adjust the pH to the optimal range for the LAL reaction

blocks.zh: 透析 — 去除小分子干擾物（較少使用）
blocks.en: Dialysis - removes small-molecule interfering substances (less commonly used)

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵提醒：任何克服干擾的處理方法都必須驗證「不會造成內毒素損失」。有些處理（如加熱）可能同時破壞內毒素，導致假陰性 — 這比干擾本身更危險。
blocks.en: Key reminder for CDMOs: Any treatment used to overcome interference must be shown not to cause endotoxin loss. Some treatments (such as heating) may also destroy endotoxin and lead to false negatives - which is more dangerous than the interference itself.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某客戶產品的干擾因子測試結果：加入 5.0 EU/mL 標準內毒素後，測得 Solution B 為 8.5 EU/mL，Solution A 為 0.3 EU/mL。回收率是多少？是否通過？
blocks.en: In a client product's interference test, after spiking 5.0 EU/mL of standard endotoxin, Solution B measured 8.5 EU/mL and Solution A measured 0.3 EU/mL. What is the recovery, and does it pass?

blocks.zh: 你的產品在 1:10 稀釋時干擾因子測試不通過（回收率 35%），但 MVD 只有 1:20。你還有多少空間來嘗試進一步稀釋？如果 1:20 仍不通過，你的下一步是什麼？
blocks.en: Your product fails the interference test at a 1:10 dilution (recovery 35%), but the MVD is only 1:20. How much room do you have to try a higher dilution? If 1:20 still fails, what is your next step?

blocks.zh: 你選擇加熱處理來克服干擾。如何設計實驗來同時證明（a）干擾被消除，且（b）內毒素沒有被破壞？
blocks.en: You choose heat treatment to overcome interference. How would you design experiments to demonstrate both (a) that the interference has been eliminated and (b) that the endotoxin has not been destroyed?

blocks.zh: 2.2 Test Procedure, Calculation & Interpretation — 測試程序、計算與結果判讀
blocks.en: 2.2 Test Procedure, Calculation & Interpretation

blocks.zh: 光電法結果判定的三重保障：
blocks.en: Three safeguards for a valid photometric result:

blocks.zh: 標準曲線驗證（Condition 1）：確認儀器和試劑系統正常 — r ≥ 0.980
blocks.en: Standard curve verification (Condition 1): confirms the instrument and reagent system are working properly - r ≥ 0.980

blocks.zh: 回收率驗證（Condition 2）：確認樣品不會干擾測試 — 50%–200% 回收
blocks.en: Recovery verification (Condition 2): confirms the sample does not interfere with the test - 50%-200% recovery

blocks.zh: 陰性對照驗證（Condition 3）：確認無外來汙染 — Solution D 低於偵測極限
blocks.en: Negative control verification (Condition 3): confirms there is no extraneous contamination - Solution D below the detection limit

blocks.zh: 三個條件全部滿足，測試才算有效。任一條件不滿足，結果無法使用，必須調查原因並重做。
blocks.en: All three conditions must be met for the test to be valid. If any one is not met, the result cannot be used, and the cause must be investigated and the test repeated.

blocks.zh: 結果報告：光電法報告的是平均值（mean），而非最差值。但樣品的稀釋和濃度修正必須正確 — 忘記乘回稀釋倍數是最常見的計算錯誤。
blocks.en: Reporting results: For photometric methods the mean is reported, not the worst value. However, dilution and concentration corrections must be applied correctly - forgetting to multiply back by the dilution factor is the most common calculation error.

blocks.zh: 完整結果計算範例
blocks.en: Worked Calculation Example

blocks.zh:
產品：注射液 50 mg/mL
內毒素限值：2.0 EU/mg
測試稀釋：1:100
LAL 方法：動態顯色法（λ = 0.005 EU/mL）

MVD = (2.0 EU/mg × 50 mg/mL) / 0.005 EU/mL = 20,000
實際稀釋 1:100 < MVD 20,000 → 合格

測試結果（Solution A 重複）：
  Replicate 1: 0.032 EU/mL
  Replicate 2: 0.028 EU/mL
  Mean: 0.030 EU/mL

修正回原液濃度：
  0.030 EU/mL × 100（稀釋倍數）= 3.0 EU/mL

轉換為 EU/mg：
  3.0 EU/mL ÷ 50 mg/mL = 0.06 EU/mg

限值 = 2.0 EU/mg
結果 0.06 EU/mg < 2.0 EU/mg → PASS
blocks.en:
Product: injection solution 50 mg/mL
Endotoxin limit: 2.0 EU/mg
Test dilution: 1:100
LAL method: kinetic chromogenic (λ = 0.005 EU/mL)

MVD = (2.0 EU/mg × 50 mg/mL) / 0.005 EU/mL = 20,000
Actual dilution 1:100 < MVD 20,000 → acceptable

Test results (Solution A replicates):
  Replicate 1: 0.032 EU/mL
  Replicate 2: 0.028 EU/mL
  Mean: 0.030 EU/mL

Corrected back to the undiluted solution:
  0.030 EU/mL × 100 (dilution factor) = 3.0 EU/mL

Converted to EU/mg:
  3.0 EU/mL ÷ 50 mg/mL = 0.06 EU/mg

Limit = 2.0 EU/mg
Result 0.06 EU/mg < 2.0 EU/mg → PASS

blocks.zh: CDMO 的數據完整性要求：
blocks.en: Data integrity requirements for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 所有 BET 結果（包括標準曲線、對照品、重複測試）都必須記錄在受控系統中
blocks.en: All BET results (including standard curves, controls and replicate tests) must be recorded in a controlled system

blocks.zh: 計算過程（稀釋修正、單位轉換）必須可追溯
blocks.en: The calculation process (dilution correction, unit conversion) must be traceable

blocks.zh: 軟體計算結果必須經過 CSV（Computer System Validation）驗證
blocks.en: Software-calculated results must be verified by CSV (Computer System Validation)

blocks.zh: 異常結果（OOS）必須依照 SOP 啟動 OOS 調查流程
blocks.en: Abnormal results (OOS) must trigger an OOS investigation in accordance with the SOP

blocks.zh: Hold Time Study 連結：BET 結果也用於驗證製程中的 hold time（保留時間）。例如，配液到充填之間的等待時間中，內毒素是否會因微生物增殖而升高？Hold time 驗證中的 BET 時間點數據直接影響你的製程窗口設計。
blocks.en: Link to hold time studies: BET results are also used to validate in-process hold times. For example, during the wait between compounding and filling, could endotoxin rise because of microbial proliferation? The BET time-point data in a hold time study directly affect the design of your process window.

blocks.zh: 在上述計算範例中，如果分析員忘記乘以稀釋倍數 100，直接報告 0.030 EU/mL，這個錯誤會造成什麼後果？（提示：0.030 EU/mL vs 3.0 EU/mL 都低於限值，但哪個是正確的？）
blocks.en: In the calculation example above, if the analyst forgets to multiply by the dilution factor of 100 and reports 0.030 EU/mL directly, what would be the consequence? (Hint: both 0.030 EU/mL and 3.0 EU/mL are below the limit, but which one is correct?)

blocks.zh: 某批次 BET 結果：Solution C 的 r = 0.992，Solution D = 0.002 EU/mL（低於偵測限），但 Solution B 的回收率為 45%。你會如何處理？
blocks.en: In a batch BET, Solution C gives r = 0.992 and Solution D = 0.002 EU/mL (below the detection limit), but the recovery for Solution B is 45%. How would you handle this?

blocks.zh: 2.3 Inhibition/Enhancement Test for Gel-Clot Techniques — 凝膠法干擾因子測試
blocks.en: 2.3 Inhibition/Enhancement Test for Gel-Clot Techniques

blocks.zh: 過敏原測試的比喻：干擾因子測試就像在做過敏原測試。你要確認你的「偵探」（LAL）在特定「環境」（產品）中是否還能正常工作。如果偵探在這個環境中的靈敏度（找到目標的能力）沒有明顯改變（0.5λ–2λ），那就證明這個環境不會「過敏性地」影響偵探的表現。
blocks.en: An allergy test analogy: The interference test is like an allergy test. You need to confirm that your "detective" (LAL) still works properly in a particular "environment" (the product). If the detective's sensitivity (its ability to find the target) does not change significantly in this environment (0.5λ-2λ), that shows the environment does not "allergically" affect the detective's performance.

blocks.zh: 使用更靈敏 LAL 的策略意義：原文特別提到，使用更靈敏的 LAL（更小的 λ）可以獲得更大的 MVD，從而允許更大的稀釋倍數來克服干擾。這是 CDMO 在技術轉移初期就應該評估的重要參數：
blocks.en: Strategic significance of using a more sensitive LAL: The original text specifically notes that using a more sensitive LAL (smaller λ) gives a larger MVD, which allows a greater dilution to overcome interference. This is an important parameter for a CDMO to evaluate early in technology transfer:

blocks.zh: λ = 0.125 EU/mL 的 LAL → MVD 較小 → 對干擾性產品可能不夠
blocks.en: LAL with λ = 0.125 EU/mL → smaller MVD → may be insufficient for interfering products

blocks.zh: λ = 0.03 EU/mL 的 LAL → MVD 增大約 4 倍 → 更大的稀釋空間
blocks.en: LAL with λ = 0.03 EU/mL → MVD about 4 times larger → more room for dilution

blocks.zh: λ = 0.005 EU/mL 的 LAL → MVD 增大約 25 倍 → 幾乎所有產品都能克服干擾
blocks.en: LAL with λ = 0.005 EU/mL → MVD about 25 times larger → interference can be overcome for almost all products

blocks.zh: 但更靈敏的 LAL 也更昂貴，且對操作環境的無內毒素要求更高。
blocks.en: However, a more sensitive LAL is also more expensive and places stricter demands on keeping the working environment endotoxin-free.

blocks.zh: 為什麼干擾因子測試要求 Solution A（無添加內毒素的產品）的所有重複結果都必須是陰性？如果 Solution A 有一個重複為陽性，代表什麼？
blocks.en: Why must all replicates of Solution A (product without added endotoxin) be negative in the interference test? What does it mean if one replicate of Solution A is positive?

blocks.zh: 你在進行新客戶產品的技術轉移。產品是一種含防腐劑的眼科注射液（pH 6.5）。預測可能的干擾類型和來源，並提出克服策略。
blocks.en: You are carrying out the technology transfer of a new client product: an ophthalmic injection (pH 6.5) containing a preservative. Predict the likely types and sources of interference and propose strategies to overcome them.

blocks.zh: 凝膠法 vs 光電法的干擾測試差異：
blocks.en: Differences between interference testing by gel-clot and photometric methods:

blocks.zh: 為什麼凝膠法要求更多重複？因為凝膠法是主觀判讀（+/−），變異性較大，需要更多數據點來確保統計可靠性。
blocks.en: Why does the gel-clot method require more replicates? Because gel-clot reading is subjective (+/-) and more variable, more data points are needed to ensure statistical reliability.

blocks.zh: 2.4 Recombinant Factor C (rFC) — 重組 Factor C 替代方案
blocks.en: 2.4 Recombinant Factor C (rFC) Alternative

blocks.zh: 天然胰島素 vs 重組胰島素：rFC 對 LAL 的關係，就像重組人胰島素（Humulin）對豬胰島素的關係。早期糖尿病治療依賴從動物（豬/牛）胰臟提取的胰島素，後來基因工程技術讓我們能在實驗室中生產完全相同的人類胰島素 — 供應更穩定、品質更均一、不依賴動物來源。rFC 也是同樣的進化路徑。
blocks.en: Natural vs. recombinant insulin: The relationship of rFC to LAL is like that of recombinant human insulin (Humulin) to porcine insulin. Early diabetes treatment relied on insulin extracted from animal (porcine/bovine) pancreas; genetic engineering later made it possible to produce identical human insulin in the laboratory - with more stable supply, more uniform quality and no dependence on animal sources. rFC follows the same path of evolution.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 rFC 策略考量：
blocks.en: rFC strategy considerations for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 供應鏈優勢：LAL 依賴鱟血液採集，受限於季節性、環保法規和地理限制。rFC 的供應更穩定，價格可預測
blocks.en: Supply chain advantage: LAL depends on the harvesting of horseshoe crab blood and is limited by seasonality, environmental regulations and geography. The supply of rFC is more stable and its price more predictable

blocks.zh: 法規風險：某些市場（如日本 PMDA）對 rFC 的接受度仍較保守，使用前需確認目標市場的法規要求
blocks.en: Regulatory risk: Some markets (e.g., Japan PMDA) are still conservative about accepting rFC, so the regulatory requirements of the target market must be confirmed before use

blocks.zh: 過渡策略：許多 CDMO 採用「平行驗證」策略 — 同時使用 LAL 和 rFC 進行平行測試，累積比較數據後逐步過渡
blocks.en: Transition strategy: Many CDMOs adopt a "parallel validation" strategy - testing with LAL and rFC side by side, accumulating comparative data, and then transitioning step by step

blocks.zh: ESG 加分：使用 rFC 符合動物福利和永續發展的企業社會責任（ESG）目標，這對歐美客戶是加分項
blocks.en: ESG benefit: Using rFC supports corporate social responsibility (ESG) goals on animal welfare and sustainability, which is a plus with European and US clients

blocks.zh: 重要：使用 rFC 時，USP RSE 的校正可能需要額外驗證步驟，因為 RSE 原本是針對 LAL 校正的。確認 rFC 試劑供應商提供的校正方案。
blocks.en: Important: When using rFC, calibration of the USP RSE may require additional verification steps, because the RSE was originally calibrated against LAL. Confirm the calibration scheme provided by the rFC reagent supplier.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在考慮從 LAL 全面轉換為 rFC。列出你需要向法規當局提交的比較數據類型和數量。
blocks.en: Your CDMO is considering a full switch from LAL to rFC. List the types and amount of comparative data you would need to submit to regulatory authorities.

blocks.zh: 一位客戶的產品含有大量 β-glucan（如某些醣蛋白藥物）。使用標準 LAL 時干擾因子測試反覆失敗。rFC 如何解決這個問題？
blocks.en: A client's product contains a large amount of β-glucan (e.g., some glycoprotein drugs). The interference test repeatedly fails with standard LAL. How does rFC solve this problem?

blocks.zh: 從供應鏈管理的角度，分析 rFC 對 CDMO 的長期價值。如果鱟的保育法規在五年內進一步收緊（限制 LAL 產量），你的 CDMO 應該現在做什麼準備？
blocks.en: From a supply chain management perspective, analyze the long-term value of rFC for a CDMO. If horseshoe crab conservation regulations tighten further within five years (restricting LAL production), what should your CDMO be preparing now?

blocks.zh: rFC 的工作原理：在天然 LAL 級聯反應中，Factor C 是第一個接觸內毒素的蛋白質。rFC 技術將這個關鍵蛋白質透過基因工程（通常在昆蟲細胞或哺乳動物細胞中表達）大量生產，完全不需要採集鱟的血液。
blocks.en: How rFC works: In the natural LAL cascade, Factor C is the first protein to contact endotoxin. rFC technology produces this key protein in quantity by genetic engineering (usually expressed in insect or mammalian cells), with no need to harvest horseshoe crab blood.

blocks.zh: rFC vs LAL 的關鍵差異：
blocks.en: Key differences between rFC and LAL:

blocks.zh: 2.5 USP Reference Standards & Footnotes — USP 參考標準品與腳註
blocks.en: 2.5 USP Reference Standards & Footnotes

blocks.zh: K 值體系的全貌：
blocks.en: The full K value system:

blocks.zh: K = 5 EU/kg — 絕大多數注射劑（IV, IM, SC 等）的標準閾值，基於人體能耐受的最大內毒素劑量
blocks.en: K = 5 EU/kg - the standard threshold for the vast majority of injectables (IV, IM, SC, etc.), based on the maximum endotoxin dose a human can tolerate

blocks.zh: K = 0.2 EU/kg — 鞘內注射的嚴格閾值（是一般的 1/25），因為中樞神經系統對內毒素極度敏感
blocks.en: K = 0.2 EU/kg - the stricter threshold for intrathecal injection (1/25 of the usual value), because the central nervous system is extremely sensitive to endotoxin

blocks.zh: 175 EU/V — 放射性藥物的特殊規定，因為放射性藥物通常劑量小、用量急，使用 70 kg 體重 × 5 EU/kg / 2 (safety) 簡化而得
blocks.en: 175 EU/V - a special provision for radiopharmaceuticals, because radiopharmaceuticals usually have small doses and urgent use; it is derived in simplified form from 70 kg body weight × 5 EU/kg / 2 (safety)

blocks.zh: 100 EU/m² — 以體表面積計算劑量的抗癌藥物專用
blocks.en: 100 EU/m² - used specifically for anticancer drugs dosed by body surface area

blocks.zh: Footnote 1 的意義：在驗證去熱原程序時，需要使用靈敏度 ≥ 0.15 EU/mL 的 LAL。這確保了驗證測試有足夠的靈敏度來偵測殘留的內毒素挑戰品。
blocks.en: Significance of Footnote 1: When validating depyrogenation processes, an LAL with sensitivity ≥ 0.15 EU/mL is required. This ensures the validation test has enough sensitivity to detect the residual endotoxin challenge.

blocks.zh: 放射性藥物內毒素限值計算
blocks.en: Endotoxin Limit Calculation for Radiopharmaceuticals

blocks.zh:
範例：一種 Tc-99m 標記的診斷劑
最大注射體積 V = 5 mL

非鞘內給藥：
  Endotoxin Limit = 175 / V = 175 / 5 = 35 EU/mL

鞘內給藥（如果適用）：
  Endotoxin Limit = 14 / V = 14 / 5 = 2.8 EU/mL

注意：放射性藥物通常有較短的有效期，
BET 測試必須在衰變前完成 — 這對測試
周轉時間（turnaround time）有極高要求。
blocks.en:
Example: a Tc-99m labeled diagnostic agent
Maximum injection volume V = 5 mL

Non-intrathecal administration:
  Endotoxin Limit = 175 / V = 175 / 5 = 35 EU/mL

Intrathecal administration (if applicable):
  Endotoxin Limit = 14 / V = 14 / 5 = 2.8 EU/mL

Note: radiopharmaceuticals usually have a short shelf life,
so the BET must be completed before decay - this places
very high demands on test turnaround time.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 K 值管理實務：
blocks.en: K value management in practice for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 每個客戶產品的內毒素限值必須在技術轉移文件中明確定義
blocks.en: The endotoxin limit for each client product must be clearly defined in the technology transfer documents

blocks.zh: K 值的選擇由給藥途徑決定 — 如果客戶變更給藥途徑，內毒素限值必須重新計算
blocks.en: The K value is determined by the route of administration - if the client changes the route, the endotoxin limit must be recalculated

blocks.zh: 某些產品可能有多種給藥途徑（如同一種藥品可 IV 或 IT 給藥）— 必須以最嚴格的限值為準
blocks.en: Some products may have more than one route of administration (e.g., the same drug given IV or IT) - the strictest limit must apply

blocks.zh: 各論（monograph）中如果有特定的內毒素限值，以各論為準，而非用 K/M 公式重新計算
blocks.en: If a monograph specifies an endotoxin limit, the monograph limit applies, rather than recalculating with the K/M formula

blocks.zh: 某抗癌藥物以體表面積計量，最大劑量為 500 mg/m²，濃度為 10 mg/mL。計算其內毒素限值（EU/mg 和 EU/mL）及 MVD（λ = 0.03 EU/mL）。
blocks.en: An anticancer drug is dosed by body surface area, with a maximum dose of 500 mg/m² and a concentration of 10 mg/mL. Calculate its endotoxin limit (EU/mg and EU/mL) and the MVD (λ = 0.03 EU/mL).

blocks.zh: 一位客戶原本的產品標示為 IV 注射，現在要追加鞘內注射的適應症。對你的 CDMO 而言，這在 BET 測試方面意味著什麼改變？列出所有需要重新評估的項目。
blocks.en: A client's product was originally labeled for IV injection and an intrathecal indication is now being added. What does this change for your CDMO in terms of BET testing? List all items that need to be re-evaluated.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 光電法干擾因子測試：在產品中加入已知量標準內毒素，回收率必須在 50%–200% 範圍內，否則判定有干擾
blocks.en: Photometric interference test: Add a known amount of standard endotoxin to the product; recovery must be within 50%-200%, otherwise interference is concluded

blocks.zh: 結果有效性三條件：標準曲線 r ≥ 0.980 + 回收率 50%–200% + 陰性對照低於偵測限
blocks.en: Three conditions for a valid result: standard curve r ≥ 0.980 + recovery 50%-200% + negative control below the detection limit

blocks.zh: 克服干擾策略：進一步稀釋（不超過 MVD）、使用更靈敏 LAL、加熱處理、過濾、中和、透析
blocks.en: Strategies for overcoming interference: further dilution (not exceeding the MVD), a more sensitive LAL, heat treatment, filtration, neutralization, dialysis

blocks.zh: 凝膠法干擾測試：在產品中做標準內毒素系列稀釋，幾何平均終點必須在 0.5λ–2λ 範圍
blocks.en: Gel-clot interference test: prepare a series of standard endotoxin dilutions in the product; the geometric mean endpoint must be within 0.5λ-2λ

blocks.zh: rFC 替代方案：基因工程生產的重組 Factor C，無動物來源、無 β-glucan 干擾、供應穩定 — EP 已採用，FDA/USP 逐步接受
blocks.en: rFC alternative: genetically engineered recombinant Factor C, with no animal source, no β-glucan interference and stable supply - already adopted by the EP, with gradual acceptance by FDA/USP

blocks.zh: K 值體系：一般 5 EU/kg、鞘內 0.2 EU/kg、放射藥物 175 EU/V、體表面積計量 100 EU/m²
blocks.en: K value system: general 5 EU/kg, intrathecal 0.2 EU/kg, radiopharmaceuticals 175 EU/V, body-surface-area dosing 100 EU/m²

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略：每個客戶產品需獨立完成干擾因子驗證；rFC 平行驗證是前瞻性的供應鏈風險管理措施
blocks.en: CDMO strategy: each client product needs its own completed interference validation; parallel validation of rFC is a forward-looking supply chain risk management measure
